entries.title: Psalms 114:1
segments: ¶When Israel came out of Egypt, the children of Jacob from a people whose language was strange to them;

entries.title: Psalms 114:2
segments: Judah became his holy place, and Israel his kingdom.

entries.title: Psalms 114:3
segments: The sea saw it, and went in flight; Jordan was turned back.

entries.title: Psalms 114:4
segments: The mountains were jumping like goats, and the little hills like lambs.

entries.title: Psalms 114:5
segments: What was wrong with you, O sea, that you went in flight? O Jordan, that you were turned back?

entries.title: Psalms 114:6
segments: You mountains, why were you jumping like goats, and you little hills like lambs?

entries.title: Psalms 114:7
segments: Be troubled, O earth, before the Lord, before the God of Jacob;

entries.title: Psalms 114:8
segments: Who made the rock into a water-spring, and the hard stone into a fountain.
